nodes.title: SG-8.3 · Rewrite context.md and add the GDD
nodes.body:
Context: game/docs/GDD.md already has a feature index whose paths exist, and the helpers game/frontend/src/lib/docsCheck.ts and contextDoc.ts already exist. The repo-root context.md is still the original README-only placeholder with every stack entry UNKNOWN. Desired behavior: context.md names TypeScript, Phaser 3.90, React, Zustand, Radix and Vitest, notes the Go backend as out of scope, and has a module table whose paths all exist. Expected result: the test 'names the stack and references only existing module paths in the repo-root context.md' passes. Why: SG-8 needs docs that match the code.

## Acceptance criteria
- Given the repo-root context.md, when missingTerms runs with STACK_TERMS, then it returns an empty array
- Given the module table paths, when each is checked on disk, then none is missing
- Given context.md, when it is searched for 'Frameworks: UNKNOWN', then it has no match


## Scope
- In scope: Rewrite context.md purpose, stack, modules, entry points and workflows from the real code
- Out of scope: backend/ changes
- Out of scope: gameplay or UI changes
- Out of scope: new features
- Preserve: game/docs/GDD.md index and its existing paths
- Preserve: docsCheck and contextDoc behaviour
- Preserve: Phaser pinned at ~3.90.0


## Technical constraints
- Phaser stays pinned at ~3.90.0 and the phaser-pin guard test keeps passing
- No source file in game/src or game/frontend/src is over 200 lines
- game/src never imports from game/frontend
- backend/ (Go) and the contribution/round API are out of scope
- No test is deleted or skipped
- Every step lands green: npm test and npm run typecheck pass in game/ and game/frontend/


## Definition of done
- The contextDoc test passes in game/frontend
- npm test and npm run typecheck pass in game/ and game/frontend/


## Clarifying questions
- None

nodes.title: REQ · context.md names the real stack and module layout
nodes.body:
Context: context.md says the repo only holds README.md, lists the stack as UNKNOWN, and carries stale entry points, workflows and traceability text. Desired behavior: it names TypeScript, Phaser 3.90, React, Zustand, Radix and Vitest, notes Go backend as out of scope, and has a module table covering game/src, game/frontend/src, game/docs and backend. Expected result: the repo-root context test passes. Why: the doc must match the code.

## Acceptance criteria
- Given context.md, when missingTerms checks 'Phaser 3.90', 'React', 'Zustand', 'Radix' and 'Vitest', then none is missing
- Given the module table, when contextModulePaths lists its game/ and backend/ paths, then every one exists on disk
- Given context.md, when read, then it has no 'README.md only' purpose, no UNKNOWN entry points and no INT-001 traceability table


## Scope
- In scope: context.md content
- Out of scope: backend code
- Out of scope: GDD content changes
- Preserve: Module paths that already exist
- Preserve: Go backend marked out of scope


## Technical constraints
- Phaser stays pinned at ~3.90.0
- backend/ (Go) and the contribution/round API are out of scope
- No test is deleted or skipped
- Every step lands green: npm test and npm run typecheck pass in game/ and game/frontend/


## Dependencies
- INT


## Definition of done
- context.md names the real stack and a module table of existing paths


## Clarifying questions
- None

nodes.title: Act: Expand contextModulePaths into readable multi-line code
nodes.body:
Context: contextModulePaths in game/frontend/src/lib/contextDoc.ts is a one-line function that extracts the backticked game/ and backend/ paths from the module table that the repo-root context.md test checks. Desired behavior: the function is expanded to readable multi-line code with identical behaviour. Expected result: the extraction tests still pass. Why: the context.md check must stay readable and exact.

## Acceptance criteria
- Given the module table rows of context.md, when contextModulePaths receives them, then it returns the same backticked game/ and backend/ paths in the same order as before
- Given a table line without a game/ or backend/ backticked path, when contextModulePaths runs, then it adds nothing
- Given the reformatted function, when the existing contextDoc tests run, then they pass unchanged


## Scope
- In scope: game/frontend/src/lib/contextDoc.ts formatting only
- Out of scope: backend code
- Out of scope: docsCheck.ts changes
- Preserve: contextModulePaths regex and return order
- Preserve: game/docs/GDD.md


## Technical constraints
- Phaser stays pinned at ~3.90.0
- backend/ (Go) is out of scope
- No source file in game/frontend/src is over 200 lines
- Every step lands green: npm test and npm run typecheck pass in game/ and game/frontend/
- Code path: `game/frontend/src/lib/contextDoc.ts`


## Dependencies
- REQ1


## Definition of done
- contextModulePaths is multi-line with identical behaviour
- contextDoc unit tests pass


## Clarifying questions
- None
